plan.change: Bootstrap immutable trusted Change OS blob contract before retrying Phase C3-2.
expectedChanges: Add a base-owned immutable Change OS contract that validates exact Git blob identities rather than source substrings.
Protect the trusted PR/verification workflows and trusted Change OS gate tools against comment, dead-text, or semantic substitution.
Pre-authorize only the exact current trusted blobs plus the exact next C3-2 workflow/Risk Policy/static registry/static executor blobs already designed for the retry.
Make the Change OS contract verifier and contract file self-frozen after bootstrap: candidate changes to either must fail by exact base blob comparison.

Allow the C3-2 static registry/executor files to be initially absent at the bootstrap base, but once present at a later trusted base they become sticky and cannot be deleted or altered outside the pre-authorized blob.
Add adversarial tests proving comments/dead text cannot replace protected blobs, unapproved changes fail, symlink/non-regular entries fail, and self-modification fails.
Wire the new tests into Change Operations Tests and document the bootstrap/freeze rule.
hqDecisions: C3-2 must not rely on substring/static text presence for Change OS security invariants.
Before authenticated human attestation exists, security-critical Change OS self-modification is frozen to an explicit base-owned Git blob allowlist.
The only pre-authorized next variants are the already-designed C3-2 trusted verification workflow, Risk Policy, registry, and executor blobs.
The bootstrap contract itself cannot authorize its own later mutation; candidate contract/verifier must remain byte-identical to the trusted base.
This package fixes only the High finding and does not implement Trusted Static Evidence itself.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Change OS bootstrap is validated by base-owned C3-1 gates, exact-blob adversarial regression tests, and PR review. Human attestation is explicitly out of scope.
plan.rollback: Revert this staging-only bootstrap package if the contract blocks the intended exact C3-2 retry or fails to reject an unapproved protected blob.
outOfScope: General-purpose YAML or JavaScript semantic parsing
unverified: C3-2 remains incomplete until a fresh package uses this contract and passes post-merge failure/success canaries.
plan.problem: The proposed C3-2 change-operations-regression used substring presence over candidate source. A candidate could remove a real security setting and leave the same text in comments or dead strings, producing false trusted PASS.
plan.currentContract: C3-1 trusted workflows evaluate Plan/Scope/Risk/Impact from the base, but there is not yet a base-owned immutable contract for the candidate versions of security-critical Change OS workflow/tool files.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Text-presence checks cannot distinguish executable/structural security semantics from comments or dead text and therefore remain candidate-spoofable.
plan.design: Introduce tools/change-os-contract.json plus base-owned tools/change-os-contract.cjs. The verifier reads exact base and target Git trees, requires regular non-executable blobs at literal protected paths, and accepts only pre-authorized target blob IDs. Existing critical files allow their current blob plus only the exact C3-2 next blob where needed. Future C3-2 static files use sticky-optional presence: absent is allowed only while absent at the trusted base; after first appearance they cannot be deleted. The verifier and contract file themselves are self-frozen by requiring target blob equality with the trusted base blob. No candidate code is executed and no YAML/JS source semantics are inferred.
alternativesRejected: Strip comments and keep substring matching; dead branches and alternate semantics remain spoofable.
Implement a partial YAML/shell/JavaScript parser; a security boundary should not depend on an incomplete language parser.
Execute candidate Change OS tests in the trusted runner; this violates the no candidate-controlled code execution boundary.
Allow the candidate to append its own approved blob IDs in the same PR; that is self-authorization.
Freeze all workflows/tools without pre-authorizing C3-2; that would make the intended next phase impossible without another trust mechanism.
plan.migration: Bootstrap is one staging-only package. After merge, retry C3-2 from the new staging main using only the pre-authorized next blobs. The previous unsafe PR #51 stays closed and is never merged.
plan.compatibility: Current C3-1 workflows/tools are explicitly allowed. C3-2's already-designed next verification workflow and Risk Policy are explicitly allowed, and corrected C3-2 static registry/executor blobs are pre-authorized. Other protected mutations fail closed.
boundaryCases: Replacing a required workflow setting with the same text in a comment changes the blob and fails.
Moving required text into a dead string changes the blob and fails.
Changing whitespace or comments in a protected file also changes the blob and fails; this is intentional during the freeze window.
Deleting a required protected file fails.
Replacing a protected file with a symlink or executable-mode blob fails.
Adding initial C3-2 static registry/executor files is allowed only at their exact pre-authorized blob IDs.
After those files exist at the trusted base, deletion fails because sticky-optional presence becomes required.
Changing tools/change-os-contract.cjs or tools/change-os-contract.json after bootstrap fails even if candidate content tries to add its own blob to an allowlist.
Literal Git path identity is used; pathspec-like names cannot alias a protected path.
testPlan: Run Change Operations Tests including new contract unit/adversarial tests.
Require existing base-owned Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence to pass.
Request Codex adversarial review on the exact bootstrap head.
Merge staging only if no High/Medium finding remains.
Start a fresh C3-2 r0 from the bootstrap merge commit; do not reopen or reuse PR #51.
In the fresh C3-2 package, replace substring text-contract with the base-owned change-os-contract executor and confirm all candidate protected blobs match the pre-authorized values.
plan.promotionRisk: None; this is staging Change OS trust-boundary bootstrap only.
